hyph-mr.nature: 33 generic Devanagari rules: break around independent vowels and consonants, after dependent vowels; never around virama or ZWJ; break around ZWNJ; never before anusvara/candrabindu/visarga/avagraha/accents. NOT dictionary-based, NOT morphology-aware.
coverage_gaps_found: no rule for U+0931 ऱ (eyelash ra)
no rule for U+0945 ॅ / U+0949 ॉ (candra vowel signs)
no rule for U+0972 ॲ / U+0911 ऑ
no rule for nukta consonants U+0958–095F or U+093C
